title: Generate crystal structures and DFT input files
action: From the chemical formulas Ac3Ni2O7, La2BaNi2O6F, La2SrNi2O6F, construct initial crystal structures for the I4/mmm and Amam phases, assign lattice parameters and atomic positions, and create Quantum ESPRESSO input files for all required calculations (including pressure settings).
description: Prepares structural models that are the starting point for all subsequent DFT calculations.

title: DFT total-energy calculations
action: Run Quantum ESPRESSO to perform total-energy calculations for each compound, phase, pressure, and magnetic configuration. For Ac3Ni2O7 and La2BaNi2O6F at ambient pressure, compute energies of I4/mmm in NM, FM, A-AF, G-AF, C-AF and of Amam in NM. For La2SrNi2O6F at 0 GPa, same; at 4 GPa, relax the Amam structure (which should reduce to I4/mmm) and compute energies of I4/mmm in all magnetic states. Extract total energies per formula unit and magnetic moments on Ni atoms.
description: Core DFT step computing total energies and magnetic moments for all required configurations.

title: Phonon dispersion calculations
action: Using the relaxed I4/mmm structures from the DFT step, compute phonon dispersions with Phonopy for each compound at the relevant pressures: Ac3Ni2O7 at ambient, La2BaNi2O6F at ambient, La2SrNi2O6F at ambient and at 4 GPa. Record whether any imaginary (negative-frequency) modes exist along high-symmetry paths.
description: Phonon calculations to determine dynamical stability (absence/presence of imaginary modes).

title: Compile final reproduction results
action: Collect the total energies and magnetic moments from the DFT step. For each compound/pressure scenario, compute relative energies (in meV/f.u.) with respect to the nonmagnetic Amam phase energy. If the Amam phase relaxed to I4/mmm, set the NM I4/mmm entry relative_energy=0.0. For each I4/mmm phonon calculation, report imaginary_modes (true/false). For each I4/mmm entry with magnetic_state ≠ NM, include the magnetic moment per Ni atom in μB as `magnetic_moment_per_Ni_muB`. From the DFT electronic structure of the NM I4/mmm phase, extract the Δ_{z^2} splitting (eV) and, for the fluorine-substituted compounds, estimate the inter-layer magnetic coupling J⊥ S² (meV) from the energy differences between C-AF and A-AF states. Add these values as optional fields (`delta_z2_eV`, `J_perp_S2_meV`) on the relevant entries in the same JSON file at /app/outputs/results.json following the schema below.
description: Scored artifact containing all required relative energies, imaginary-mode flags, magnetic moments, electronic structure parameters, and inter-layer coupling.
output_schema: JSON array of objects. Each object has keys: compound (string: Ac3Ni2O7, La2BaNi2O6F, La2SrNi2O6F), pressure (float: 0.0 or 4.0), phase (string: I4/mmm or Amam), magnetic_state (string: NM, FM, A-AF, G-AF, C-AF), relative_energy_meV (float). Additional optional keys: imaginary_modes (boolean, only for I4/mmm entries; absent for Amam entries), magnetic_moment_per_Ni_muB (number, μB, only for I4/mmm entries with magnetic_state ≠ NM; absent otherwise), delta_z2_eV (number, optional, for NM I4/mmm entries where the paper provides the value), J_perp_S2_meV (number, optional, for the C-AF I4/mmm entry of applicable compounds).
